breadcrumb: S. flava var. rugelii Defuniak Springs, FL (extirpated)

posts.body_html: S. flava var. rugelii 'biggest seedling' defuniak springs, FL. If you're looking for a very early emerging genotype, this is the clone! Year after year, it has been producing traps way earlier than the rest and this suggests the trait is genetic. In the rest of the tray, most other plants are still dormant right now!
